extraction.input_text: When showed floorplans of the museum during the trial, Andrew pointed out all the escape routes that he and his co-conspirators had planned to use.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The narrative explicitly states Andrew's action occurred 'during the trial,' meaning it was not made out of court.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires a hearsay statement to be made out of court.

arguments.text: Andrew pointing at floorplans is non-assertive conduct that provides circumstantial evidence rather than a verbal or written assertion.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires an assertion; non-assertive conduct is not hearsay.
arguments.evidence_span: Andrew pointed out all the escape routes

arguments.text: Under FRE 801(c), hearsay is defined as an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
Because the conduct occurred in court and lacks assertive intent, it fails to satisfy the definitional elements of hearsay under FRE 801(c).
